title: Painkiller-abuse in German senior amateur Soccer
summary: In my bachelor's thesis, I am investigating the consumption of painkillers in German senior amateur soccer. The aim is to find out how often painkillers are taken, for what reasons and whether personal characteristics such as age, level of education, sporting experience or league affiliation play a role. The study is based on an anonymized questionnaire aimed at active senior players.

interventions.name:
Active German seniors (18 years +) Amateur footballers.
